# MindMaster Academy — Student & Staff Web Portal

> Dedicated learning platform, digital courseware, lecture videos, and student progress tracking for MindMaster Academy, Satara. Founded by Prashant Dhumal Sir.

This portal provides authenticated and guest access to MindMaster Academy's cognitive training curricula, Abacus & Vedic Maths course materials, and certificate validation.

## Portal Features & Navigation
- [Learning Hub Home](https://app.mindmasteredu.in/home): Student personalized dashboard, enrolled courses, and continue-learning lessons.
- [Course Catalog](https://app.mindmasteredu.in/courses): Browse comprehensive courses, video curriculums, and lesson previews.
- [Digital Books Library](https://app.mindmasteredu.in/books): Interactive learning materials, workbooks, and practice problem sets.
- [Certificate Verification](https://app.mindmasteredu.in/verify-certificate): Public credential verification tool for issued certificates.
- [Student Login](https://app.mindmasteredu.in/login): Secure student portal access via phone or email authentication.
- [Staff & Admin Portal](https://app.mindmasteredu.in/staff/login): Administrative and faculty access for batch tracking, student approvals, and CMS controls.

## Main Website
- [MindMaster Academy Website](https://mindmasteredu.in): Public website, demo session booking, parent testimonials, and contact.
